readings.title: The Valley of Dry Bones
readings.subtitle: A vision of Israel's spiritual and physical restoration from the grave of exile.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 37:1] The hand of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was upon me and took <dn>את</dn> me out by the Spirit of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and set <dn>את</dn> me down in the midst of the valley. And it was filled with bones. [2] And <dn>He</dn> made me pass among them, all around, and see, there were very many on the surface of the valley, and see, they were very dry. [3] And <dn>He</dn> said to me, <dq>“Son of man, would these bones live?”</dq> And <dn>I</dn> said, “O Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, You know.” [4] Again <dn>He</dn> said to me, <dq>“Prophesy to these bones, and you shall say to them, ‘O dry bones, hear <dn>את</dn> the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! [5] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to these bones, “See, <dn>I</dn> am bringing into you a spirit, and you shall live. [6] “And <dn>I</dn> shall put sinews on you and bring flesh upon you, and cover you with skin and put a spirit in you, and you shall live. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” ’ ”</dq> [7] And <dn>I</dn> prophesied as <dn>I</dn> was commanded. And as <dn>I</dn> prophesied, there was a noise, and there was a rattling. And the bones came together, bone to bone. [8] And <dn>I</dn> looked and saw sinews and flesh came upon them, and skin covered them, but there was no spirit in them. [9] <dn>He</dn> then said to me, <dq>“Prophesy to the spirit, prophesy, son of man, and you shall say to the spirit, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Come from the four winds, O spirit, and breathe on these killed ones, so that they live.” ’ ”</dq> [10] And <dn>I</dn> prophesied as <dn>He</dn> commanded me, and the spirit came into them, and they lived, and stood upon their feet, a very great army. [11] And <dn>He</dn> said to me, <dq>“Son of man, these bones are all the house of Yisra’ěl. See, they say, ‘Our bones are dry, our expectancy has perished, and we ourselves have been cut off!’ [12] “Therefore prophesy, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “See, O <dn>My</dn> people, <dn>I</dn> am opening your burial-sites and shall bring <dn>את</dn> you up from your burial-sites, and shall bring <dn>את</dn> you into the land of Yisra’ěl. [13] “And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, when <dn>I</dn> open <dn>את</dn> your burial-sites, <dn>My</dn> people, and bring <dn>את</dn> you up from your burial-sites. [14] “And <dn>I</dn> shall put <dn>My</dn> Spirit in you, and you shall live, and <dn>I</dn> shall settle <dn>את</dn> you in your own land. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> have spoken, and <dn>I</dn> have done it,” declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Two Sticks
readings.subtitle: The prophesied reunification of the divided kingdoms of Judah and Israel into one nation under one Shepherd.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 37:15] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [16] <dq>“And you, son of man, take a stick for yourself and write on it, ‘For Yehuḏah and for the children of Yisra’ěl, his companions.’ Then take another stick and write on it, ‘For Yosěph, the stick of Ephrayim, and for all the house of Yisra’ěl, his companions.’ [17] “Then bring <dn>את</dn> them together for yourself into one stick, and they shall become one in your hand. [18] “And when the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’ [19] say to them, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “See, <dn>I</dn> am taking <dn>את</dn> the stick of Yosěph, which is in the hand of Ephrayim, and the tribes of Yisra’ěl, his companions. And <dn>I</dn> shall give <dn>את</dn> them unto him, with <dn>את</dn> the stick of Yehuḏah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in <dn>My</dn> hand.” ’ [20] “And the sticks on which you write shall be in your hand before their eyes. [21] “And speak to them, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “See, <dn>I</dn> am taking <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl from among the nations, wherever they have gone, and shall gather <dn>את</dn> them from all around, and <dn>I</dn> shall bring <dn>את</dn> them into their land. [22] “And <dn>I</dn> shall make <dn>את</dn> them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Yisra’ěl. And one sovereign shall be sovereign over them all, and let them no longer be two nations, and let them no longer be divided into two reigns. [23] “And they shall no longer defile themselves with their idols, nor with their disgusting matters, nor with any of their transgressions. And <dn>I</dn> shall save <dn>את</dn> them from all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and <dn>I</dn> shall cleanse <dn>את</dn> them. And they shall be <dn>My</dn> people, and <dn>I</dn> be their <dn>Elohim</dn>, [24] while Daviḏ <dn>My</dn> servant is sovereign over them. And they shall all have one shepherd and walk in <dn>My</dn> right-rulings and guard <dn>My</dn> laws, and shall do them. [25] “And they shall dwell in the land that <dn>I</dn> have given to Ya‛aqoḇ <dn>My</dn> servant, where your fathers dwelt. And they shall dwell in it, they and their children and their children’s children, forever, and <dn>My</dn> servant Daviḏ be their prince forever. [26] “And <dn>I</dn> shall make a covenant of peace with them – an everlasting covenant it is with them. And <dn>I</dn> shall place <dn>את</dn> them and increase <dn>את</dn> them, and shall place <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> set-apart place in their midst, forever. [27] “And <dn>My</dn> Dwelling Place shall be over them. And <dn>I</dn> shall be their <dn>Elohim</dn>, and they shall be <dn>My</dn> people. [28] “And the nations shall know that <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, am setting Yisra’ěl apart, when <dn>My</dn> set-apart place is in their midst – forever.” ’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Northern Confederacy Gathers
readings.subtitle: Gog of Magog is summoned by YeHoVaH to lead a great army against a restored and unsuspecting Israel.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 38:1] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [2] <dq>“Son of man, set your face against Goḡ, of the land of Maḡoḡ, the prince of Rosh, Mesheḵ, and Tuḇal, and prophesy against him. [3] “And you shall say, ‘Thus says the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “See, <dn>I</dn> am against you, O Goḡ, the prince of Rosh, Mesheḵ, and Tuḇal. [4] “And <dn>I</dn> shall turn you around, and <dn>I</dn> shall put hooks into your jaws, and shall lead <dn>את</dn> you out, with <dn>את</dn> all your army, horses and horsemen, clad perfectly, a great assembly with armour and shields, all of them handling swords. [5] “Persia, Kush, and Put are with them, all of them with shield and helmet, [6] “Gomer and all its bands, the house of Toḡarmah from the far north and all its bands, many peoples with you. [7] “Be ready, prepare yourself, you and all your assemblies that are assembled unto you. And you shall be a guard for them. [8] “After many days you shall be called up. In the latter years you shall come into the land of those brought back from the sword and gathered from many people on the mountains of Yisra’ěl, which had been a continual waste. But they were brought out of the peoples, and all of them shall dwell safely. [9] “And you shall go up, coming like a storm, covering the land like a cloud, you and all your bands and many peoples with you.” [10] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “And it shall be in that day that words arise in your heart, and you shall devise an evil plan: [11] “And you shall say, ‘Let me go up against a land of unwalled villages, let me go to those at rest who dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,’ [12] to take plunder and to take booty, to stretch out your hand against the waste places that are again inhabited, and against a people gathered from the peoples, acquiring livestock and goods, who dwell in the middle of the land. [13] “Sheḇa, and Deḏan, and the merchants of Tarshish, and all their young lions shall say to you, ‘Have you come to take plunder? Have you gathered your army to take booty, to bear away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to take great plunder?’ ” ’</dq>

readings.title: YeHoVaH's Wrath Unleashed
readings.subtitle: The invasion is revealed to be YeHoVaH's plan to display His holiness and power before the nations.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 38:14] <dq>“Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and you shall say to Goḡ, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “In that day when <dn>My</dn> people Yisra’ěl dwell safely, would you not know? [15] “And you shall come from your place out of the far north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great assembly and a mighty army. [16] “And you shall come up against <dn>My</dn> people Yisra’ěl like a cloud, to cover the land – in the latter days it shall be. And <dn>I</dn> shall bring you against <dn>My</dn> land, in order that the nations know <dn>את</dn> <dn>Me</dn>, when <dn>I</dn> am set apart in you, O Goḡ, before their eyes.” [17] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Are you the one <dn>I</dn> spoke of in former days by <dn>My</dn> servants the prophets of Yisra’ěl, who prophesied for years in those days, to bring <dn>את</dn> you against them? [18] “And it shall be on that day, on the day when Goḡ comes against the land of Yisra’ěl,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“that <dn>My</dn> wrath shall come up in <dn>My</dn> face. [19] “For in <dn>My</dn> jealousy and in the fire of <dn>My</dn> wrath <dn>I</dn> have spoken, ‘On that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Yisra’ěl, [20] so that the fish of the sea, and the birds of the heavens, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping creatures that creep on the earth, and all men who are on the face of the earth shall shake at <dn>My</dn> presence. And the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall fall to the ground.’ [21] “And <dn>I</dn> shall call for a sword against Goḡ on all <dn>My</dn> mountains,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“the sword of each one being against his brother. [22] “And <dn>I</dn> shall judge with <dn>את</dn> him with pestilence and blood, and rain down flooding rain and hailstones, fire and sulphur, on him and on his bands and on the many peoples who are with him. [23] “And <dn>I</dn> shall exalt <dn>Myself</dn> and set <dn>Myself</dn> apart, and <dn>I</dn> shall be known in the eyes of many nations. And they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” ’</dq>

readings.title: The Slaughter of the Invaders
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH intervenes directly, destroying Gog's armies on the mountains of Israel.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 39:1] <dq>“And you, son of man, prophesy against Goḡ, and you shall say, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “See, <dn>I</dn> am against you, O Goḡ, the prince of Rosh, Mesheḵ, and Tuḇal, [2] and shall turn you around and lead you on, and bring you up from the uttermost parts of the north, and bring you against the mountains of Yisra’ěl, [3] and shall strike the bow out of your left hand, and make the arrows fall from your right hand. [4] “On the mountains of Yisra’ěl you shall fall, you and all your bands and the peoples who are with you. To the birds of prey of every sort and to the beasts of the field <dn>I</dn> shall give you for food. [5] “On the face of the field you shall fall, for <dn>I</dn> have spoken,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [6] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall send fire upon Maḡoḡ and on those who live undisturbed in the coastlands. And they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [7] “And <dn>I</dn> shall make <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> set-apart Name known in the midst of <dn>My</dn> people Yisra’ěl, and not let <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> set-apart Name be profaned any more. And the nations shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the Set-apart One in Yisra’ěl. [8] “See, it shall come, and it shall be done,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. <dq>“This is the day of which <dn>I</dn> have spoken. [9] “And those who inhabit the cities of Yisra’ěl shall go out and set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and armour, the bows and arrows, the clubs and spears. And they shall make fires with them for seven years, [10] and take no wood from the field nor cut down any from the forests, for with the weapons they make fire. And they shall plunder <dn>את</dn> those who plundered them, and loot <dn>את</dn> those who looted them,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Cleansing of the Land
readings.subtitle: For seven months, Israel will bury the dead to purify the land, establishing the Valley of Hamon Gog.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 39:11] <dq>“And it shall be on that day that <dn>I</dn> give Goḡ a place for a burial-site there in Yisra’ěl, the valley of those passing by east of the sea, and stopping those passing by, because there they shall bury Goḡ and all his crowd, and shall call it the Valley of Hamon Goḡ. [12] “And the house of Yisra’ěl shall bury them for seven new moons, in order to cleanse <dn>את</dn> the land. [13] “And all the people of the land shall bury them, and it shall be for a name to them on the day that <dn>I</dn> am esteemed,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [14] <dq>“And they shall separate men who continually pass through the land, burying those who were passing through, those left on the surface of the ground, in order to cleanse it. At the end of seven new moons they shall search, [15] and those passing through shall pass through the land, and when anyone sees a man’s bone, he shall set up a sign beside it, till the buriers have buried <dn>את</dn> it in the Valley of Hamon Goḡ. [16] “And also a city named Hamonah shall be there. So they shall cleanse the land.” ’</dq>

readings.title: The Great Sacrificial Feast
readings.subtitle: The birds and beasts are summoned to feast on the flesh of the fallen armies, a sign of YeHoVaH's judgment.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 39:17] <dq>“And you, son of man, thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, ‘Speak to every sort of bird and to every beast of the field, “Assemble yourselves and come, gather from all around to <dn>My</dn> slaughtering which <dn>I</dn> am slaughtering for you, a great slaughtering on the mountains of Yisra’ěl, and you shall eat flesh and drink blood. [18] “Eat the flesh of the mighty, drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams and lambs, of goats and bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan. [19] “And you shall eat fat till you are filled, and drink blood till you are drunk, at <dn>My</dn> slaughtering which <dn>I</dn> am slaughtering for you. [20] “And you shall be satisfied at <dn>My</dn> table with horses and riders, with mighty men and with all the men of battle,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [21] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall set <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> esteem among the nations. And all nations shall see <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> judgment which <dn>I</dn> have executed, and <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> hand which <dn>I</dn> have laid on them. [22] “And the house of Yisra’ěl shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> their <dn>Elohim</dn> from that day onward. [23] “And the nations shall know that the house of Yisra’ěl went into exile for their crookedness, because they have trespassed against <dn>Me</dn>, so that <dn>I</dn> hid <dn>My</dn> face from them, and <dn>I</dn> gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword. [24] “According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions <dn>I</dn> have dealt with them, and hidden <dn>My</dn> face from them.” ’</dq>

readings.title: The Spirit Poured Out
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH promises to restore the captives of Jacob, have compassion, and pour out His Spirit upon the house of Israel.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 39:25] <dq>“Therefore thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, ‘Now <dn>I</dn> am going to bring back <dn>את</dn> the captives of Ya‛aqoḇ. And <dn>I</dn> shall have compassion on all the house of Yisra’ěl, and shall be jealous for <dn>My</dn> set-apart Name. [26] And they shall have borne their shame, and all their trespass they committed against <dn>Me</dn>, when they dwell safely in their own land, with none to make them afraid, [27] when <dn>I</dn> have brought <dn>את</dn> them back from the peoples and gathered <dn>את</dn> them out of the lands of their enemies. And <dn>I</dn> shall be set apart in them before the eyes of many nations. [28] And they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> their <dn>Elohim</dn>, who sent <dn>את</dn> them into exile among the nations, and then gathered them back to their own land, and left none of them behind. [29] And no longer do <dn>I</dn> hide <dn>My</dn> face from them, for <dn>I</dn> shall have poured out <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Spirit on the house of Yisra’ěl,’</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”

readings.title: A Lamentation for Pharaoh
readings.subtitle: Pharaoh, likened to a lion and a sea monster, will be caught in YeHoVaH's net and cast upon the land.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 32:1] And it came to be in the twelfth year, in the twelfth new moon, on the first of the new moon, that the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [2] <dq>“Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh sovereign of Mitsrayim, and you shall say to him, ‘You were like a young lion among the nations, and you are like a monster in the seas, and you burst forth in your rivers, and trouble the waters with your feet, and muddy their rivers.’ [3] “Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, ‘And <dn>I</dn> shall spread <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> net over you with an assembly of many peoples, and they shall bring you up in <dn>My</dn> net. [4] And <dn>I</dn> shall leave you on the land, hurl you out on the open fields, and make all the birds of the heavens dwell on you. And with you <dn>I</dn> shall satisfy the beasts of all the earth. [5] And <dn>I</dn> shall put <dn>את</dn> your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height, [6] and water the land with the flow of your blood unto the mountains, and let streams be filled with you. [7] And when <dn>I</dn> extinguish you, <dn>I</dn> shall cover the heavens, and make its stars dark. <dn>I</dn> shall cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light. [8] All the bright lights of the heavens <dn>I</dn> shall make dark over you, and <dn>I</dn> shall bring darkness upon your land,’</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [9] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall trouble the hearts of many peoples, when <dn>I</dn> bring your destruction among the nations, into the lands which you have not known. [10] And <dn>I</dn> shall make many peoples appalled at you, and their sovereigns shall be greatly afraid of you when <dn>I</dn> swing <dn>My</dn> sword before them. And they shall tremble continually, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.’</dq>

readings.title: The Sword of Babylon
readings.subtitle: The king of Babylon will execute YeHoVaH's judgment, destroying the pride and host of Egypt.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 32:11] <dq>“For thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, ‘The sword of the sovereign of Baḇel shall come upon you. [12] By the swords of the mighty men, all of them the ruthless ones of the nations, <dn>I</dn> shall make your host fall. And they shall ravage <dn>את</dn> the arrogance of Mitsrayim, and all its host shall be destroyed. [13] And <dn>I</dn> shall destroy <dn>את</dn> all its beasts from beside its great waters, and let the foot of man trouble them no more, nor let the hooves of beasts trouble them. [14] Then <dn>I</dn> shall make their waters clear, and make their rivers run like oil,’</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [15] <dq>When <dn>I</dn> lay <dn>את</dn> the land of Mitsrayim waste, and the land shall be stripped of all that once filled it, when <dn>I</dn> have stricken <dn>את</dn> all who dwell in it, then they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [16] This is the lamentation, and they shall lament her, the daughters of the nations lament <dn>את</dn> her. Over Mitsrayim and over all her crowd they shall lament her,’</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”
